name: Privy
description:
Privy connects Claude to the marketing data in your Privy account. Ask natural-language questions about email and SMS campaigns, flows, website popups and forms, audience segments, contacts and consent, coupons, orders, products, account setup, and performance metrics. Claude can compare campaign results, identify top-converting displays, summarize flow performance, inspect segment definitions and sizes, review order and revenue trends, and help you understand what is configured across your store.

Use Privy with Claude for ecommerce marketing analytics, email and SMS performance reporting, lifecycle marketing reviews, and account audits.

All tools are read-only: Claude can retrieve and analyze Privy data but cannot change campaigns, contacts, flows, or account settings. Access is scoped to the paid Privy business you select during secure OAuth sign-in. No API token or custom OAuth application is required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Privy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Privy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.privy.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Privy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Privy lists 35 MCP tools, including get_account, get_account_setup, get_campaign, get_campaign_report, get_contact, get_coupon, get_coupon_code, get_display, get_display_report, get_flow, get_flow_report, and get_identity.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Privy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Privy in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Privy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Privy is developed by Privy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
